name: site-coleta-dados-combustivel
description: AOP3 - site de divulgacao dos precos de combustiveis de Vila Velha/ES

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix packages/shared && npm run check --prefix apps/api && npm run check --prefix apps/web
scripts.compose:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
